findings.title: Positive feedback: pilot supervisor cohort engagement stayed strong without reminder nudging
findings.description: Customer reports the mill-supervisor pilot cohort has high, self-sustaining engagement: a skeptical veteran supervisor (Ferg) has not missed a session, and account-wide active usage sits at ~78% over the last 30 days, up from the low-70s. The customer stopped sending her own reminder emails in April and engagement did not drop. This is offered as praise/status update, not a complaint or request for a product change.
findings.quote: My read is it's sticky. Sessions are getting booked without me nagging, which is the metric I actually care about.
findings.severity_reason: No defect or gap raised; purely positive status commentary with no action requested.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue applies; this is unsolicited positive feedback, not a bug or feature request.

findings.title: Positive feedback: coach-to-coach handoff preserved session history and continuity
findings.description: When one director's coach moved on, the handoff to the replacement coach was seamless: the new coach already had the prior transition notes and knew what the member had been working on, so the member avoided a 'start from zero' reset. Customer explicitly calls this out as working well in practice, not as a problem needing a fix.
findings.quote: the handoff to the new coach was seamless. She didn't even flag it to me until after, said the transition notes were all there.
findings.severity_reason: No defect present; customer confirms the continuity feature performed as intended.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue applies; this is praise for existing coach-handoff continuity behavior, not a new problem.
